purpose: Disentangle enumeration instruction, unknown-row reporting burden, digital ROI and independently captured optical information.

inputDefinitions.O: One new original overview of a static physical state, not a prior evaluation image.
inputDefinitions.R: Lossless semantic-area crop of O, fixed before object labels/model outputs; sourceSHA and transform pinned. Not independent holdout.
inputDefinitions.V: A real separately captured closer/angled view of the same unchanged state and semantic area; not warp/zoom of O.
inputDefinitions.video: Short real phone sweep from the same state with timestamps; independently annotate whether pieces/hands move. Preserve time order for state segmentation.

dataPrerequisites: Capture permission and local evaluation use rights recorded. No commercial media copied into product assets.
Actual model-evaluation exposure history recorded; existing developer images cannot be relabeled as new.

Human annotator labels all visible allowed physical units and independently readable values before model output, with object layer, box/polygon, occlusion, group/individual alternative and uncertainty.
Second human resolves material ambiguity where available; otherwise disputed label remains unscorable. Model-assisted labels are not human-certified.
No inventory-based counting or inferred hidden card/owner. Source owner/epoch explicitly supplied from capture session.
Freeze images, source transformations, reference, per-route prompt/schema, response budget, sequence and scoring code hashes.
If new static-scene inputs or manual labels are unavailable, stop paid planning at frozen-empty status; do not use Risk/Chess as fabricated fullboard GT.

requestLimits.claim: one durable claim per exact bodyHash and inputHash
requestLimits.firstTransportFailure: stop dispatch, preserve receipt; no automatic recovery
requestLimits.429: record failure and stop further dispatch, no reissue
requestLimits.truncationOrMalformed: count as failed/partial evidence, no retry

conditions: Current standard service tier, below long-context boundary; no extra services.
Both formulas assume the stated input ceiling; image token estimate must be defensible for Terra before sending.
If model-specific input bound cannot be established, mark cost upper bound UNKNOWN and return a smaller concrete plan; do not treat reserve as permission.
Record actual cache/input/output/reasoning usage once returned; do not double-count reasoning already included in output.
Provider invoice, taxes, credits and transport-failure charges remain UNKNOWN.

pairedInvariants.scope: all three scenes, current native/generic route separately
two generic scenes; same schema, not nullable-kind intervention

pairedInvariants.onlyDifference: image bytes and pinned image/transform provenance
pairedInvariants.scope: two generic scenes; prompt/schema identical; actual tokens may differ

multiviewComparisons.fairness: The two-view alternatives both use two calls and same cap. Single vs two calls is a cost-benefit comparison, not equal spend. Common-region and newly visible region reported separately.
multiviewComparisons.correspondence: Report raw oracle union and current real editable fusion separately. Human GT matches cannot be counted as product registration.
multiviewComparisons.catan: No crop/multiview inference in this first package; native canonical placement adds a different contract.

offlineSelectorPlan.inputs: same captured timestamped video for old/new selector; manual full-visible/readability references frozen first
conditions: uniform-time selection as offline comparator only
offlineSelectorPlan.commonBound: same maximum selected frames=6; also report actual selected count and upload bytes
metrics: distinct physically visible reference units covered
selection CPU, decode/encode time, peak memory, thermal/device context
doNotInfer: zero selected is not proof every frame unreadable
same hash is not unchanged state proof
frame coverage is not semantic completeness

wholeObject: precision of all returned physical units
group surface utility and optional visible quantity separately
unsupported/uncertain GT excluded with denominator shown
fusion: unresolved preserved but not counted as recovered
user: time/actions to human-correct and physically reconstruct
cost: calculated USD vs actual invoice UNKNOWN

acceptanceRules: No fabricated percentage cutoff. Compare added correct restoration information against new false positives/wrong values/correction effort and cost.
If P1/P2 improves only row count, schema validity or selected-region metric, do not adopt as whole-scene gain.
If V reveals no additional scorable information over O/R, do not make cross-view registration a required implementation.
Regression: raw preservation, null vs 0, scope/owner/epoch, manual edits, reverse completion, redelivery, adjacent identical pieces and board/piece layers.
No claim of 120-game accuracy; single trials remain weak evidence. Results used to tune become development evidence.
executionChecklist: Approved bounded runner only, no product default mutation
Independent scorer retains original reference and reports ambiguity
Return results including failures, not just favorable cases

timingProtocol.primaryPurpose: Prompt/reporting and information-source discrimination, not a service speed certification.
timingProtocol.pairedWallMeasured: P2 whole + independent view only: N05/N07 and N10/N12 concurrently, peak2; start/end/claim times recorded.
timingProtocol.registeredCropWall: P2 whole reused with later crop; max(per-call times) is an ESTIMATE only, not measured parallel wall.
timingProtocol.promptTimingCaveat: Single trial, fixed different order and different concurrency context for P2; observed latency differences cannot isolate the instruction effect. Cache and queue effects recorded.
timingProtocol.measurementBoundary: Record only milestones actually observed in a connected isolated product path. Standalone provider times, offline merge times and reused results cannot be summed and labeled measured capture-to-final. If no connected path is available in this round, end-to-end and human restore times remain UNKNOWN; no extra paid requests allowed to fill the gap.
